title: bed tent pirate
text: bed tent pirate. Pirate bed tent.  The upside, comes in a nylon bag with good handles and zippered.  The tent is made of a stiff, nylon material.  Comes with printed instructions and is put together like a pup tent with stringed poles. Really need 2 people in order not to get too frustrated. Took longer than you would hope. Sigh.  In the ad they note they are including a cute flashlight that also functions sort of like the old toys you inserted photo wheels into (view master) - comes with 8 little wheels.  They also note you'll need to provide the batteries.  But.  What they don't mention is you will will need watch batteries!  1.55v little coins (surprisingly they are not all the same size either - some are tiny).  I don't keep those on hand.  Good thing my grandson hasn't arrived yet. I've got time to purchase them.  I just assumed it would a AAA or AA.  Eh.  The flashlight is really low quality junk.  But you have to have the batteries to try it!  Over all, 3 stars is fair.  But they do need to include specifics on the batteries or include them.  Oh. I bought 2.  The pirate and space ship version.  They are both 'ok.'
